description: The popped-out chat window, granted only what its code calls: events (every chat update arrives as one, and it reports what it shows to the main window; `onMoved`, `onResized` and `onThemeChanged` are event listeners too), the window reads it uses to remember its bounds, and reading and setting its theme. It does not get `core:default` (no tray, menu, image, path or webview access) or `process:allow-restart`. Opening, closing and focusing windows go through Ember's own commands, so no window-management permission is granted here.
